create_milvusclient_instance: create a MilvusClient instance to connect to a multi-tenant Milvus vector database
upsert_vector_items: upsert a list of VectorItem objects into a named Milvus collection for vector storage
search_similar_vectors: search a Milvus collection for similar vectors using cosine distance and return ranked results
delete_collection_items: delete items from a Milvus collection by IDs, metadata filters, or resource ID
query_collection_items: query all items from a Milvus collection with optional metadata filters and result limit
